replacements.text: a test that keeps the routing table the only model inventory

The routing table in the delegation skill is meant to be the only inventory of model ids. Nothing enforced that. A new test suite now reads the Markdown files under `src/`, except those under an `evals` or `node_modules` directory. The suite fails `make ci` on a model id the table does not list. Anthropic aliases such as `sonnet` are not caught.
Rejecting a word that is not a model id makes the test block every pull request.
The patterns are case-sensitive. 94 files in the real repository tree pass the test.
Nothing ships from the test file. Therefore, delete it.
An unlisted id appended to a skill made `make content-tests` exit 2. The command named the line.
A pytest test suite beside the delegation skill fails on an unlisted model id. It fails on a table row elsewhere that names any id. It fails on a routing table that changes shape.
Each vendor naming scheme has one case-sensitive pattern. Consequently, a family name in prose is not an id.
The test allows two tables in the routing file. Therefore, the routing file's Providers table became a list.
The spec defines ids by vendor naming scheme. An alias does not follow a vendor naming scheme.
An unlisted model id in any Markdown file the test reads under `src/` causes a failure. The failure names the file and the id.
A fenced example (an example in a Markdown code block) with a listed id fails once its routing-table row is removed.
An absent or empty routing table causes a failure. The failure names the routing table.
A table row outside the routing table that names a listed id fails. The same id in prose passes.

A pytest test suite beside the delegation skill reads every Markdown file under src/, except those under an evals or node_modules directory. It fails on an unlisted model id, a table row elsewhere naming a model id, or a routing table with changed shape. The suite allows two tables in the routing file. Therefore, the file's Providers table becomes a list.

make ci exits 0 at the head (the current commit). 20 content suites pass. All 34 cases fail against a stub lint (a checker returning no files or violations). All pass at the head. One unlisted id appended to a skill made the gate exit 2. The gate named the line. Anthropic aliases are not caught. No review round ran.
